status: SMOKE RUN ONLY: teacher trained 8192 steps on 30 train worlds; 4 val and 2 test worlds. Not the intended ~1 hour scale: the numbers show the pipeline runs end to end, not what a trained teacher distils to.
comparison_note: Hand-written from the exported depth-4 tree of this smoke run. It splits first on recall_offer_visible, then on day_frac, phase_EXEC_A, payroll_payable/firm_cash and DART.borrowed_frac, and every leaf is a reduce action (BRIN, GALA, DART, ALTO, FENN, ELAN). bot:v1's PM rules cover recalled BRIN while no replacement borrow is accepted, and sell the largest long on a margin call. The tree's root leaf (reduce BRIN 1.0 while the recall offer is not visible) touches the same name on a different trigger; the tree has no margin-call split. With an 8192-step teacher this is weak evidence either way.
reproduce: cd ml && uv run --group train --with scikit-learn python scripts/distill_viper.py --steps 8192 --families 40 --workers 16 --depths 2,4 --iterations 2
weight_proxy: max minus min masked log-probability of the teacher over valid actions (see distill.py)
selection: per depth: VIPER iterate with best mean val reward; exported tree: depth <= 4 with best val reward (ties to the shallower)
